//: Stage 3 GCP bootstrap — provisions the fluid-iactest-runner service account, the project-level role bindings the live tests need, and the impersonation grant from the runner's user principal. Run once per GCP project. The test suite gates on ``FLUID_IAC_LIVE_GCP=1`` plus reachable ADC.

project_id.description: GCP project ID hosting the Stage-3 test resources.

region.description: Default region for regional resources (BQ datasets, Cloud Run services, etc.).

user_principal.description: IAM principal that will impersonate the test SA. Format: ``user:alice@example.com`` or ``group:eng@example.com``. Granted ``roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator`` on the SA so ADC-based impersonation works without service-account key files (which the project's org policy blocks).

fluid_test_runner.description: Service account impersonated by tests/iac/test_iac_gcp_real_e2e.py. Provisioned + destroyed per test via tofu, identity scoped to fluid-iactest-* resources.

fluid_test_consumer.//: Cross-project-consumer proxy SA for Stage 3 cross-project tests. The deployer (fluid_test_runner OR the user principal) gets serviceAccountTokenCreator on this SA so the test session can impersonate it and verify that the contract's google_bigquery_dataset_iam_member grant actually authorises a BQ read. A REAL cross-project test would have this SA in a SECOND project — same member-string syntax (serviceAccount:<email>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com), same dataset-IAM grant shape. Boundary-crossing across projects/folders is the only thing we can't exercise on a single sandbox project.
fluid_test_consumer.description: Consumer proxy SA for cross-project IAM-grant LOGIC tests.

sa_sa_user.//: The SA needs ``iam.serviceAccountUser`` on itself so that tofu (impersonating it) can attach the SA to Cloud Run / Composer / etc. during apply. Also lets the SA pass itself to BigQuery scheduled queries.

sa_token_creator.//: Needed so the SA can mint tokens for ADC-style impersonation chains (e.g. a Cloud Run service impersonating this SA at runtime).

user_can_impersonate.//: Grants the runner's user principal ``serviceAccountTokenCreator`` on the test SA. Combined with ADC, this lets tofu (and Python SDKs) impersonate the SA from the user's auth — no SA JSON key file needed, which matters when org policy ``constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation`` is set.

user_can_impersonate_consumer.//: Same token-creator grant for the consumer SA so the test session can impersonate it.

runner_can_impersonate_consumer.//: Also let the runner SA mint consumer tokens — supports the impersonation chain when tests run via the runner SA (e.g., via WIF in CI).
